label: Electron desktop app
description: A desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux on Electron and TypeScript, with tests and a README.
task: Scaffold an Electron desktop app with TypeScript in this empty folder. Create package.json with the scripts start (build, then launch Electron), build and test (vitest run); a main process in src/main.ts that opens one window with contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off and a sandboxed renderer; a preload in src/preload.ts that exposes one small, typed API through contextBridge; and a renderer page (index.html with src/renderer.ts) that uses it. Set up Vitest with one test for a pure function the app uses. Add a .gitignore for node_modules and the build output, and a README.md that says what the app is and how to install, run, test and package it.

create.note: Electron Forge's starter. Run it in the new folder before you press Run; the run then builds on what it created.
